text:
Sam (People Ops): Hey team — placed a kiddo with me through county social services last night (emergency foster placement, placement dated 2026-03-01). Can I add them to my benefits outside open enrollment? What proof do you need and how fast do I have to submit?
Lena (Benefits): This is typically a QLE (placement for foster care). You should have 30 days from the placement date to submit. Required docs usually: placement letter from county social services, the placement agreement, the child’s birth certificate (if available), and SSN when you get it.
Aisha (Manager): @Sam — do you want any immediate approvals for care while benefits are pending?
Sam (People Ops): Ideally yes — clinic visit tonight for stitches. Don’t want claim denied.
Lena (Benefits): We can file an interim authorization with the carrier for urgent care while we process the QLE. Upload the placement letter + any ID in the portal and ping me.
Chris (Payroll): Note payroll side: if enrollment is approved, premiums will be pro-rated from the effective date you choose (placement date allowed). If you pick retro effective date, retro deductions appear on next payroll. Also if you get monthly benefits credits, they start the effective month.
Sam (People Ops): What counts as acceptable upload? Phone photos ok?
Lena (Benefits): Phone photos are fine as long as they’re legible. Please include the social worker’s contact info in the upload so we can validate quickly. If documents are in another language, include a translated version.
Sam (People Ops): Where do I upload? Don't want to accidentally email unsecurely.
Lena (Benefits): Use the secure portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/qle-upload (internal only). If you must email, use the secure upload mailbox: secure-uploads@redwood.com and include this as the subject exactly:
```
Subject: QLE - Emergency placement - Sam - 2026-03-01
Attach: placement_letter.pdf, placement_agreement.pdf, birth_certificate_or_id.pdf, ssn_if_available.pdf
```
HRbot: Ticket created: HR-5499 — "QLE: emergency foster placement (Sam)" (assigned to Lena).
Chris (Payroll): If the SSN is missing, enter "TBD" in the portal so the system can process enrollment; update SSN once you have it.
Aisha (Manager): Also, Sam, document any time off you're taking for appointments so we can coordinate coverage.
Sam (People Ops): Uploaded placement_letter.jpg and placement_agreement.jpg to portal just now. Pinged Lena.
Lena (Benefits): Received — thanks. I'll request interim authorization for tonight's urgent care and start QLE review. Expect confirmation within 48 hours. :thumbsup:
